name: segmented-control
summary: Presents a compact set of mutually exclusive linked views or filters.

agent.useWhen: A compact set of links switches a resource list, filter, or presentation mode.
agent.avoidWhen: Content panels switch in place as tabs or options submit one form value.

invariants: Two to eight items contain exactly one current item. Link requires a safe href; current and disabled forbid href.
Current uses aria-current=page and disabled content is noninteractive with aria-disabled=true.
equalWidth defaults to false. Native JSON hrefs accept whole named routes calls; the host checks route existence, argument types, codecs and emission provenance.
